decisions.reason: The check-in app builds on the firm's airport passenger-handling know-how, and pandemic demand for contactless processing supports keeping it, although consumer app development lies further from its security core and there is no website evidence after 2019.
PassBoard sits closest to the firm's core passenger screening and processing expertise, and its in-house technology team can interpret client feedback and adapt it as aviation recovers.
Self-service check-in builds on the firm's established airline relationships and operational knowledge, and contactless trends after COVID make it worth refining rather than dropping.
